releases.title: Claude or OpenAI, your choice

highlights.title: Claude or OpenAI
highlights.text: ✨ Comment ideas now work with either provider. Switch any time in AI settings.

highlights.title: Pick any model
highlights.text: Load the models your own key can use, choose one and test the connection.

highlights.title: See your token usage
highlights.text: Tokens per day, feature and model, so you always know what AI costs you.

changes: New AI settings sheet (⚙︎ › AI settings): Claude and OpenAI keys, model picker loaded from your key, connection test, token usage per day, feature and model
Keys are entered in a native secure prompt and stored in the iOS Keychain; the page only ever sees them masked
Comment ideas go through one shared AI call, following the app-blueprints AI configuration
✨ Suggest, moods and language buttons stay hidden until a key is saved
Comment ideas are labelled with the provider that wrote them
Your existing OpenAI key and model move over automatically
The thinking-effort setting is gone: choose a model instead

releases.title: Tidier header

highlights.title: Matching header icons
highlights.text: Settings and refresh are now the same size and easier to tap.

changes: Settings and refresh icons drawn as matching line icons with larger tap areas
fixes: Settings icon looked smaller than the refresh icon

releases.title: Settings, right in the app

highlights.title: Settings screen
highlights.text: Tap the gear in the header to change how the digest works, no code editing.

highlights.title: Manage your API key
highlights.text: Replace or remove your OpenAI key any time; only its last 4 characters are shown.

highlights.title: Check for updates now
highlights.text: See your version and look for a new one with a single tap.

changes: Settings sheet behind a gear icon in the header
AI settings: API key, default mood, custom prompt, language, model and thinking effort
Digest settings: own activities, extra details, names on the widget
Update settings: turn offers on or off, check now
Advanced: Strava athlete ID
Settings are kept in the iOS Keychain, so updates never reset them

releases.title: Comments in your mood

highlights.title: Comment moods
highlights.text: Pick Funny, Energetic, Serious or Funky and get three comments in that tone.

highlights.title: Your own prompt
highlights.text: Type how you want it, like "tease about the rain", and the AI follows.

highlights.title: Remembers your style
highlights.text: Your mood and custom prompt stay selected for next time.

changes: Mood chips in the comment box: Funny, Energetic, Serious, Funky and Custom
Custom prompt field that drives the AI suggestions
Mood and custom prompt are remembered between runs

releases.title: Never miss an update

highlights.title: Update reminders
highlights.text: The digest tells you when a new version is out. Tap Later and it waits two days before asking again.

highlights.title: One-tap update
highlights.text: Update right from the digest. No need to run the installer again.

highlights.title: See what's new first
highlights.text: Every update shows its three best features before you install it.

changes: Update check on start, with a pitch sheet showing the top three highlights
Later snoozes update reminders for two days
Version number shown at the bottom of the digest
Release notes now live in releases.json, with a generated CHANGELOG.md

releases.title: Kudos to everyone, with style

highlights.title: Pinned header
highlights.text: Today, Yesterday and the 👍 All button stay at the top wherever you scroll.

highlights.title: Kudos celebration
highlights.text: Thumbs fly from the centre to every athlete's photo, with a ✓ as each one lands.

highlights.title: Cleaner screen
highlights.text: No more stuck pop-up at the bottom, and kudos counts look right again.

changes: Sticky header in the Go2FGym style with a compact day switcher and an always-visible 👍 All button
Celebration animation when giving kudos to everyone
Day switcher limited to Today and Yesterday
fixes: Pop-up message no longer peeks out at the bottom of the screen
Kudos counts were drawn as large orange circles

releases.title: A proper photo viewer

highlights.title: Zoom photos
highlights.text: Double-tap or pinch to zoom, and drag around while zoomed in.

highlights.title: Thumbnail strip
highlights.text: See the previous and next photos, and tap one to jump straight to it.

highlights.title: Big close button
highlights.text: An always-visible Close photo button, so you never leave the app by accident.

changes: Pinch and double-tap zoom in the photo viewer
Thumbnail strip with the current photo highlighted
Large Close photo button at the bottom
Date bar stays pinned while scrolling
fixes: Swiping between photos stopped working after zoom was added

releases.title: Stable comments

highlights.title: No more crashes
highlights.text: Posting a comment no longer loads Strava's heavy page every time.

highlights.title: Faster comments
highlights.text: After the first comment, the rest are sent with one small request.

highlights.title: Honest confirmation
highlights.text: Only Strava's real reply to your comment counts as posted.

changes: Learns Strava's comment request once and reuses it
fixes: Scriptable could be closed by iOS while posting a comment
A tracking request could be mistaken for a posted comment

releases.title: Widget and details

highlights.title: Kudos widget
highlights.text: See how many people are waiting for your kudos on the Home or Lock Screen.

highlights.title: Activity details
highlights.text: Route map, all stats and bigger photos, without leaving the digest.

highlights.title: Pull to refresh
highlights.text: Drag the digest down at the top to reload today's feed.

changes: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
Activity details sheet with route map
Pull to refresh
Loading screen with a running figure and a live post counter

releases.title: Who's waiting for kudos

highlights.title: Waiting first
highlights.text: People still waiting for your kudos are grouped at the top.

highlights.title: Comment animation
highlights.text: Watch your comment fly to your friend, with confetti when it lands.

highlights.title: Fun loading screen
highlights.text: A runner collects posts while a counter ticks up.

changes: Waiting for your kudos and Kudos given sections
Screen locks with an animation while a comment is sent
Animated loading screen with post counter

releases.title: First public release

highlights.title: Kudos to everyone
highlights.text: Two taps give one kudos to each person in the day's feed.

highlights.title: AI comment ideas
highlights.text: Funny, friendly comments built from each activity's real stats.

highlights.title: Grouped by athlete
highlights.text: One card per person with the numbers that matter up front.

changes: Daily digest of the people you follow, grouped by athlete
One kudos per person, plus kudos to everyone
AI comment suggestions in English and Lithuanian
Early-riser badges, photo viewer, start times and PRs
